notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
It has come to my attention that different qualities make Hero move slower or faster, so if you are noticing that you are too slow in game, go to the settings and change to a lower quality. Ill try and find a fix

Also if you are getting an error that your game cant be started, you will have to disable Unreal Engine firewalls from your antivirus. I cannot disable the firewall ( That I know of )

notes.title: Final ( Kinda ) Update!
notes.notes:
The full game is released! However there may still be bugs that Im going to fix over time as they come up
The end story sequence also doesnt have a voiceover sequence just yet, im waiting for the person who did the original

However I hope you guys enjoy the game! Have fun in the world of Kenestria!

Fixes : Tutorial doesn't force you to walk up to the book to read how to walk. It starts off telling you how to do so
Changed how the text box works on the inside, to hopefully limit bugs.
Made the light guardian blocking box bigger ( Just a small fix )
Gave the sapphire forest bandits a higher chance to drop Kenestrium ( Super rare and powerful material )
Moved the skip intro button so the Steam popup doesnt block it ( Although you could also just disable the intro in settings )

Changes : 
No more skip text button! Now you gotta read >:D
Made the text scroll faster so not having a skip text button doesnt affect you as much
Clarified the umbranox dragon fight text stuff

notes.title: Bug Fixes + Additional Content
notes.notes:
First things changed were some bugs, including :
When getting into a fight with a Distantia Fallen knight, the game would softlock
Ability to spam spells and take no damage in return
Made it so you can no longer save in the broken town, because that caused camera issues.

Additional content :
New items! Strong Health Potion and Soul Crystals
New Enemy! Soul Collector ( Unlocked after starting one of the new sidequests in Distantia forest )
2 New Sidequests in Distantia Forest, both located in the broken town after completing the Xioxon quest!
New sidequests give access to Strong Healing Potions and Strong spells, so both useful!
( Quests only appear after compelting Xioxon's quest and then leaving and re-entering Distantia forest )

Next update Im going to be adding 2 new areas, apposed to the normal one area I usually do!
However, due to this it may take me longer to get the update out, so hopefully some of this new content can tide you guys over!

Until next time,
- Lightsaber09 at Gigsjaw

notes.title: Post-Halloween Update
notes.notes:
With Halloween now over, we have taken out our dear friend Punkin. But don't worry he'll be back, and much much harder to kill >:)

Also added new area in Clara forest with 2 new enemies. 
New enemy now has chance to drop Rare ( double enchanted ) items

notes.title: Magic Update
notes.notes:
Added a new weapon type "Staves", which also come with a new weapon stat / enchantment. 
Staves have spell damage added to them, which  increase how much damage spells do.
The Magic enchantment also increases the damage that spells do.

Next items to be added will most likely be armor centered around magic users.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes: Added some additional UI for the Inventory that shows your health, and the stats of items when you hover over them.

notes.title: Storage Box Update ( V11 )
notes.notes: The world of Kenestria now has multiple storage boxes scattered around. The storage box can hold 25 items, and all storage boxes have a shared inventory.  The Red side with a down arrow deposits items, where the blue side with an up arrow withdraws items.

notes.title: The SPOOK Plague Patch
notes.notes:
Just a small patch, changed a few minor things.

The game now has a new Icon, rather than the old Unreal logo its the Divine Lyre.
Changed the Gigsjaw Logo on the main menu to be updated to our new Halloween logo ( Thank you Buddomas )

Lastly I changed something with Punkin, where he now spawns in 1 of 5 locations when you open the forest level ( That includes after battles, so try walking to make sure you dont get into fights as much )

Once again, thank you all for the support. Next update I'll be sure to have a major change ( Probably a working tutorial )

notes.title: Update V5
notes.notes:
Added new Skill tree system, as you level up you gain skill points that you can put into 1 of 4 trees to level up stats such as defense, attack, or gain skills to help turn the tide of battle. 

! IF YOU ALREADY ARE LEVELED UP IN THE GAME, RESET YOUR SKILL TREE TO GET THE LOST SKILL POINTS !

Skill trees : 

Strength - adds Attack

Dexterity - adds Crit + Attack Speed

Constitution - adds Defense and Resistance 

Intelligence - adds MP Regen and Spell Damage

Small fixes :

Fixed a few areas you could get stuck or leave the designated play area ( Harpoons on dock, gap in the dock, small area in the carper town wall )

! IF YOU ALREADY ARE LEVELED UP IN THE GAME, RESET YOUR SKILL TREE TO GET THE LOST SKILL POINTS !
